result_text:
The warehouse stock list no longer includes products with zero quantity. The fix is one filter in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1490): `WHERE s.quantity > 0`, the same condition the other stock overviews use.

`findStockQuantity` is untouched, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still returns 0. The only caller of the list is `StockService.getWarehouseStock`.

I ran `StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `WarehouseTransferTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` offline and they passed. I did not add a regression test for the bolt/nut example. Nothing is committed.
